content_review.reviewer_note: 部分完整（约束=True，密度映射=False，HEX 锚 9）：保持 draft，缺口已记录不猜值

legacy_payload.best_for: 数学与理科概念的直观可视化讲解：帮助读者理解「它是什么、为什么成立、几何/结构直觉是什么、在不同场景下如何表现」；手绘教育海报质感的数学讲义与知识科普，优雅、清晰、信息丰富但不杂乱
legacy_payload.visual_direction: high-quality math lecture notes fused with hand-drawn educational poster: elegant, clear, information-rich yet uncluttered; clean light paper background, deep blue title, black/dark-gray body linework, sparse elegant blue/teal/gold/red accents; rounded cards, thin-line borders, numbered labels, hand-drawn arrows, zoom callout boxes, a summary bar; balanced academic look where the reader sees the concept's STRUCTURE and the WHY at a glance

canvas.aspect_ratio: 16:9 (vertical portrait optional; horizontal default for PPT)
canvas.background: clean light paper background (warm white #FAF7F2 or very pale paper, optional faint paper grain that never hurts readability)
canvas.composition: one core concept as the hero: a structure diagram or geometric-intuition figure, definition card, zoom callout(s), and a bottom summary bar; numbered labels and hand-drawn arrows define a single reading path
canvas.density: medium — information-rich but ordered, every element explains the structure or the why

color_palette.primary: deep blue title #1E3A8A, near-black body linework #1F2937
color_palette.secondary: elegant blue #2563EB, teal #0E7490 for structure and labels
color_palette.accent: gold #C9A227 and red #DC2626, used sparingly for the key 'why' / conclusion / important condition
color_palette.rule: academic restraint: deep blue title + black/gray body are the skeleton; blue/teal mark structure, gold/red mark the one or two decisive points; avoid rainbow, neon, heavy gradients, or large dark blocks

typography.title: clear, confident deep-blue title (Inter / 思源黑体, or a restrained serif Georgia / 思源宋体), authoritative and legible
typography.body: black / dark-gray body linework, clean and readable; formulas and symbols set precisely with proper spacing
typography.labels: numbered labels, small annotations, step markers, condition tags
typography.text_quality: mathematical symbols, formulas, variables, and Chinese/English terms must be exact; preserve the core concept term; do not garble notation or invent unrelated labels

layout_patterns: 「是什么」定义卡 + 结构图 + 局部放大框
「为什么成立」定理 + 手绘箭头推导/直觉链 + 结论金句
几何 / 结构直觉图 + 编号标签 + 局部放大框
不同场景表现对比（圆角卡片并列）+ 一句共性
概念总览 + 结构骨架 + 底部总结栏
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: Use layout_blueprints as candidate starting points only. Identify the slide's teaching goal first: introduce-what / prove-why / build-intuition / show-variants. Every slide must make the concept's STRUCTURE and the WHY visible — not just state the formula. Lead with one core figure, annotate with numbered labels and hand-drawn arrows, use one or two zoom callouts for the decisive detail, and close with a one-line summary bar. Keep it elegant and information-rich, never cluttered.

layout_blueprints.name: 概念结构页（是什么 + 结构）

labels: 结构图 / 几何直觉主图

layout_blueprints.name: 为什么成立页（定理 + 直觉链）

labels: 手绘箭头推导 / 直觉链（3-5 步）

layout_blueprints.name: 跨场景表现页（变体对比）

visual_elements.allowed: rounded cards, thin-line borders, numbered labels, hand-drawn arrows, zoom callout boxes (局部放大框), summary bar, structure diagrams, geometric figures, coordinate hints, small condition/legend annotations, faint paper grain
visual_elements.avoid: cluttered layout, rainbow or neon colors, heavy gradients, dense unreadable formula walls, cartoon mascots, decorative blobs, stock photography, fake 3D

rendering_constraints: The slide must look like a high-quality math lecture note + hand-drawn educational poster: elegant, clear, information-rich but not cluttered.
The reader must see the concept's STRUCTURE and the WHY at a glance — lead with a structure/intuition figure, not a wall of formulas.
Mathematical notation, formulas, variables, and terms must be exact and correctly typeset.
Keep the deep-blue-title + black/gray-body skeleton; use blue/teal for structure and gold/red only for the one or two decisive points.
Rounded cards and thin borders organize, they do not decorate; numbered labels and hand-drawn arrows define one reading path.
No watermark, no unrelated logo, no fabricated theorem or attribution.
For multi-scale science, use 6-8 varied scale boxes with unit/magnification labels; avoid identical scale boxes and generic magnifier-style layouts. (awesome-gpt-image-2 · scientific-scale-diagram)
